offer.text: The archive runs short of {supply_name}. Bring me {count} and I'll see the records kept.

accept.text: Wonderful. Knowledge survives only as long as its keepers are stocked.

decline.text: A pity. The unwritten page forgets so quickly.

in_progress.text: Have you found {count} {supply_name} for the archive?

ready.text: {count} {supply_name} — the shelves will breathe again. Thank you.

complete.text: A scholar's gratitude is a lasting thing. This is yours.
